description: This file defines the 'CalculatorView' SwiftUI view and its associated view model 'CalculatorCardViewModel'. It provides a calculator UI allowing users to input a number, perform basic arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide), and view the result.

classes.name: CalculatorCardViewModel
classes.description: ObservableObject class managing the calculator's input, result, and operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the input value to the current result.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts the input value from the current result.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the current result by the input value.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides the current result by the input value, handling division by zero as NaN.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the input and result to initial states.

methods.name: parseInput
methods.description: Parses the input string into a Double, handling both comma and dot decimal separators.
